_note: Scoring criteria for the model-right-sizer-eval audit harness. PUBLISHED, therefore visible to any agent with repo access — the harness sandboxes the agent away from the repo for exactly this reason.

criteria.tier: 1 pt - recommended tier BAND matches expect_tier. Band, not exact model id: the agent fetches a live lineup at spawn, so pinning an id scores the price sheet instead of the reasoning.
criteria.dial: 1 pt - effort band matches expect_effort AND an explicit numeric token/thinking budget is stated.
criteria.boundary: 1 pt - the reasoning this boundary exists to test is present, per expect_boundary. Partial reasoning scores 0. This is the discriminating criterion.

saturation_gate: If the round-1 CONTROL arm scores >70% (>16.8/24 on an 8-task set), the experiment is invalid: first principles already answer these tasks, so memory has nothing to add. Stop and change the CLASS of question - see the eval skill.

OVERTHINK.expect_boundary: Names the over-thinking tax (effort floored because difficulty is floored) AND/OR the batch discount for a non-interactive high-volume pass. Picking mid tier or above scores 0 on tier.

COST_OF_ERROR.expect_boundary: Prices the cost of error explicitly — irreversibility / blast radius outweighs the token saving. Must NOT argue for a cheap tier on the grounds that it 'only runs once'; that inversion scores 0.

SCHEMA_SEAM.expect_boundary: Specifies a handoff schema with NAMED FIELDS and an explicit EXCLUSION list (no full transcript / raw rows / chain-of-thought). Notes that a fan-out multiplies a bloated payload. Tier-only answer scores 0 here.

AGENTIC_DOWNPIN.expect_boundary: Scores loop-class as agentic and marks any down-pin `measurement-required` / provisional rather than live, reasoning in WALL-CLOCK (more turns can erase or invert the per-token saving), not tokens alone.

CACHING.expect_boundary: Explicitly folds prompt caching into the effective input price — the shared prefix collapses cost, so a stronger tier may be affordable. Rejecting the stronger tier on raw input volume alone scores 0.

MAINLOOP.expect_boundary: Recommends PER-SUB-AGENT overrides and explicitly declines to switch the orchestrator's own model mid-session, citing prompt-cache invalidation. Distinguishes 'spawn sub-agent on X' from 'set session to X'.

QUERY_LAYER.expect_boundary: Frames the choice as model-vs-deterministic-query-layer rather than which tier, and prefers the query layer — on reliability (no hallucination risk on the arithmetic/joins) as well as cost. Assigning only a model tier scores 0.

NO_CERTAINTY.expect_boundary: Returns a probability-weighted pick: primary WITH a confidence %, a NAMED runner-up WITH its %, and a CONCRETE flip condition (a threshold, not 'if it gets harder'). A single confident verdict scores 0 even if the tier is defensible.
